description: LeadDeck workflows for real estate agents to find, qualify, prioritize, and work transaction opportunities.

defaultPrompt: Find me 10 opportunities from this expired listing file.
Find the best expired opportunities for this Pocket Buyer.
Run Opportunity Checker on these aged expireds.
interface.longDescription: LeadDeck helps real estate agents turn aged expired listing files into a prioritized hand of qualified opportunities. Opportunity Checker researches current market status, identifies the best opportunities for a Pocket Buyer or Target Buy Box, ranks them, and creates a LeadDeck-ready seller CSV.

name: leaddeck
